payload.title: Mutual check-in: per-task negotiated windows
payload.revision_note: Bruce: check-in windows should be adjusted and agreed each time, not a global default.
payload.principle: Don't leave each other on read. Checking means work progressed and not stuck.

protocol.per_task_windows: Whoever assigns the work proposes a check-in time. The owner agrees or counters. No global default.
protocol.check_cadence: Medic checks every 15 minutes (cheap file read). Escalation only when a task passes its agreed window with no progress.
protocol.escalation: Stale past agreed window -> Bruce hears about it.

payload.medic_side: Live. 15m checks, per-task windows. Current: queue-fix-revision (4h), winterbloom-readiness (8h).
payload.rivet_side_ask: Mirror on your side with per-task windows, or counter-propose.
